places.name: Rue Laffitte
places.connection: Claude Monet was born in Paris, and Rue Laffitte is a significant location related to his early life.

places.name: Giverny
places.connection: Giverny is where Claude Monet created the Haystack series, depicting the rural landscape surrounding his home.

places.name: Claude Monet's House and Gardens
places.connection: Monet's studio in Giverny, where he painted the Haystack series.

places.name: Musée d'Orsay
places.connection: The Musée d'Orsay is one of the museums where Claude Monet's Haystack series is displayed.

places.name: Art Institute of Chicago
places.connection: The Art Institute of Chicago houses several paintings from Monet's Haystack series.
